headline: Minister Şimşek: We expect growth to increase - ensonhaber.com
summary: Turkish Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek said the economy grew 2.3% year on year in the second quarter. He expects growth to accelerate gradually, driven by disinflation and better global conditions.
why: Turkey's growth and disinflation path shape the central bank's rate decisions and the outlook for the lira and Turkish assets.
